# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.69

- **Word export with image boxes (from a tester's request).** New command **Export DOCX…** in the File menu and under the settings, and a fourth pencil, **DOCX image box** (orange). Draw a rectangle around a figure, diagram or scheme on a processed page: the exported `.docx` has the page's text as before, and the box cut from the page as a picture at its place in the reading order (inside the right column of a column section, left / centred / right by its position). The text inside the box is not recognised, and stays out of the PDF text layer and the `.txt` too. From the command line the boxes come from a project (`page1.page_image_boxes = X,Y,W,H; …`). Choose Colour or Grey output for photos. Checked by a unit test and a run on a synthetic page; **not yet opened in Word itself**. The EPUB and TEI exports do not embed the pictures.
- **Large phone photos fixed.** A 48 MP photo without a resolution in its header was read as a 300 dpi page 677 mm tall; Tesseract read 42 of 64 words of a test page, many wrong. Pictures longer than 5600 px with no usable header resolution are now assumed to frame an A4 page (the window and the command line both): 64 of 64 words. Smaller photos and A3 scans are not touched.
- **Curved-page duel** in `docs/DUEL.md`: on pages bent by a formula only `--dewarp` repairs them (1-4 % CER against 33-92 % for the others; page-dewarp with defaults 20-41 %). The bend is the shape the dewarp assumes, so this is home ground; no photographed book was measured. `scripts/duel.py` gets `--dewarp`, and the ocrmypdf runs now pass `--image-dpi` (they had failed on PNGs without a resolution).
- **PDF/A validation widened**: Romanian text with diacritics in three more veraPDF-checked files (bw OCR, hybrid OCR, colour OCR), and a check that the diacritics reach the text layer.
- **Dependency**: `wasmi` 2.0.0 (and its `wasmi_core`) was yanked from crates.io, which made the weekly/PR `cargo audit` fail; moved to 2.0.1 (lock file only).
